title: Transcendence: Hermite-Lindemann / Lindemann-Weierstrass
shortDescription: Hermite-Lindemann (1882): for nonzero algebraic α, e^α is transcendental. Lindemann-Weierstrass (1885): for Q-linearly-independent algebraic α₁..αₙ, the e^αᵢ are algebraically independent over Q. Project status: axiomatized in HermiteLindemann.lean; this slug coordinates bridge work to existing infrastructure rather than re-formalising from scratch.

insights: Slug duplicates substantial existing transcendence infrastructure: HermiteLindemann.lean (390 lines, 1 axiom), eTranscendental.lean (304 lines, 1 sorry), ETranscendentalOQ0{1,2,3}.lean (538/715/219 lines, 0/1/2 axioms), PiTranscendental.lean (457 lines, 1 sorry). Total 2,623 lines of related work.

Parent placement under `nth-root-irrational` is technique-mismatched: parent is *algebraic-irrationality of irreducible-polynomial roots* (purely algebraic), this OQ is *transcendence over Q* (analytic/auxiliary-polynomial techniques). Effective parent should be `e-transcendental-*` family.

Two adjacent axioms are tractable bridge targets: (1) `irrational_liouvilleWith_two` in ETranscendentalOQ03.lean:114 (Dirichlet's approximation lower bound, ~30-60 line proof from Mathlib); (2) `e_not_liouvilleWith_gt_two` in ETranscendentalOQ03.lean:154 (sharp upper bound via regular CF expansion of e, harder ~100-200 lines).

Full Hermite-Lindemann proof is ~900 lines of formalisation (auxiliary polynomial + integral identity + prime-selection contradiction). Mathlib has active upstream PR work; long-term right move is to bridge to upstream rather than re-formalise.
Status field must be `axiomatized` (per Axiom Integrity Policy): main result depends on `axiom hermite_lindemann` plus 2 OQ03 axioms plus 4 sibling sorries. Never mark `verified`.

builtItems.summary: Dirichlet's approximation theorem in `LiouvilleWith` form: every irrational has irrationality measure ≥ 2. Discharges the easier of two axioms on the irrationality-measure-of-e file.

builtItems.name: rat_approx_bounded_den_finite
builtItems.signature: (x : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : {q : ℚ | |x - (q : ℝ)| < 1 / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧ q.den ≤ N}.Finite
builtItems.summary: Slice-finiteness helper: the set of good rational approximations to `x` with denominator ≤ N is finite. Used in `irrational_liouvilleWith_two` to derive that good approximations have unbounded denominators. Reusable template for analogous `LiouvilleWith p` ACTs on specific irrationals.
